_comment: Vulcan reference calibration: model (h, v) mm at 1:72 -> page px (u, v) = A @ [h, v, 1]. Images are not in git (ref/ is ignored).

plan._source: aerospaceweb.org Vulcan 3-view (vulcan_schem_01.gif, 466 x 334), enlarged x4 (Lanczos). Plan view, nose right. Low resolution: one source pixel is about 1.5 mm at 1:72. x from the length without the probe (nose col 282, tail col 12 = 30.45 m), y from the span (rows 11 to 326 = 33.83 m): the plan's span is drawn about 4% larger than its length, so the two axes have their own scales.

side._source: Same drawing, port side view (nose left). Nose tip col 180, row 280.5; tail col 451.

front._source: Same drawing, head-on view. Span 302 px (drawn at the side view's scale). Fuselage centre col 313, row 58.75 (z 4.7).
